crossRefs.note: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.
Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.
An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.
A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that…
For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
crossRefs.keyword: in due season. Heb. in his season

crossRefs.note: The Lord Yahweh has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him who is…
crossRefs.keyword: in due season. Heb. in his season

crossRefs.note: David said to Abigail, “Blessed is Yahweh, the God of Israel, who sent you today to meet me!
Blessed is your discretion, and blessed are you, who have kept me today from blood guiltiness, and from avenging myself…

translations.web: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
translations.bsb: A man takes joy in a fitting reply— and how good is a timely word!
translations.kjv: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good
translations.asv: A man hath joy in the answer of his mouth; And a word in due season, how good is it!
